commands.summary: Reads the colour a person sees at a point, the mean of a 1, 3 or 5 pixel square; null on empty canvas.
commands.title: Sample Color

commands.summary: Exports the rectangles as JSON text.
commands.title: Export JSON

commands.summary: Redoes the last undone edit.
commands.title: Redo

commands.summary: Undoes the last edit.
commands.title: Undo

commands.summary: Empties this app's recent list.
commands.title: Clear Menu

commands.summary: Opens, places or hands off each file as if dropped on the window; returns the actions taken.
commands.title: Drop Files

commands.summary: Hands the open document to another app that reads it.
commands.title: Open In

commands.summary: Opens a file from this app's recent list.
commands.title: Open Recent

commands.summary: This app's recent files, newest first.
commands.title: Recent Files

commands.summary: Turns a linear gradient to an angle in degrees about its box's centre.
commands.title: Gradient Angle

commands.summary: Sets the selection's gradient: its type, 2 to 64 stops and a linear fill's angle.
commands.title: Set Gradient

commands.summary: Reads the selection's fill: its type, stops and a linear fill's angle.
commands.title: Read Fill

commands.summary: Adds a stop at an offset in the colour the gradient shows there.
commands.title: Add Gradient Stop

commands.summary: Sets a stop's colour and opacity (a solid's colour at index 0); changes under one drag token are one undo step.
commands.title: Gradient Stop Color

commands.summary: Moves a stop to an offset; moves under one drag token are one undo step.
commands.title: Move Gradient Stop

commands.summary: Removes a stop; a gradient keeps at least two.
commands.title: Remove Gradient Stop

commands.summary: Makes the selection's fill solid, linear or radial.
commands.title: Fill Type

commands.summary: Opens a named request: each step an agent records until history.end carries its name, so history.undo-request can undo them together.
commands.title: Begin Request

commands.summary: Closes the open request; later steps carry no request.
commands.title: End Request

commands.summary: Undoes or redoes until the given number of steps is applied; the jump records no step.
commands.title: Jump in History

commands.summary: Reads the history: the state before the first step, every step's name and who made it, how many are applied, which was saved and the open request.
commands.title: Read History

commands.summary: Undoes every step of the named request in one call. Refused when any later step follows the request's steps.
commands.title: Undo Request

commands.summary: Pans the picture inside its box to a unit focus; moves under one drag token are one undo step.
commands.title: Move Inside

commands.summary: Places a PNG, JPEG or SVG fitted inside the canvas at a point, or with fill into the selected layer.
commands.title: Place Image

commands.summary: Reads the selected placed image: its file, natural size, box, focus and drawn rect.
commands.title: Read Placed Image

commands.summary: Shows another file in the selected placed image's box.
commands.title: Replace Image

commands.summary: Gives the selected image's box its natural aspect, keeping its width and centre.
commands.title: Reset Size

commands.summary: Adds a rectangle with the given frame and selects it.
commands.title: Add Rectangle

commands.summary: Lists every rectangle, back to front.
commands.title: List Rectangles

commands.summary: Moves the selected rectangle by an offset; moves under one drag token are one undo step.
commands.title: Move Rectangle

commands.summary: Removes the selected rectangle.
commands.title: Remove Rectangle

commands.summary: Selects the rectangle with the given id.
commands.title: Select Rectangle

commands.summary: Draws one shape of the given kind and options in a box, as one undo step.
commands.title: Draw Shape

commands.summary: Gives the selection a 1 pt black stroke with a miter join and a butt cap.
commands.title: Add Stroke

commands.summary: Sets how the stroke's open ends finish: butt, round or square.
commands.title: Stroke Cap

commands.summary: Sets the stroke's colour; changes under one drag token are one undo step.
commands.title: Stroke Color

commands.summary: Dashes the stroke with a preset scaled by its width, or a pattern and phase in points.
commands.title: Stroke Dash

commands.summary: Sets how the stroke's corners meet: miter, round or bevel.
commands.title: Stroke Join

commands.summary: Reads the selection's stroke: colour, width, join, cap, dash and trim; null when it has none.
commands.title: Read Stroke

commands.summary: Removes the selection's stroke.
commands.title: Remove Stroke

commands.summary: Trims the stroke to start and end fractions, turned by an offset in turns; a scrub under one drag token is one undo step.
commands.title: Trim Path

commands.summary: Sets the stroke's width in points, 0 to 1000; a scrub under one drag token is one undo step.
commands.title: Stroke Width

commands.summary: Picks the shape tool with the given kind and options.
commands.title: Shape Tool

commands.summary: Mirrors the selection about its centre: Flip Horizontal or Flip Vertical.
commands.title: Flip

commands.summary: Reads the selection's box, turn and mirrors.
commands.title: Transform

commands.summary: Turns the selection back to 0 and clears its mirrors.
commands.title: Reset Rotation

commands.summary: Turns the selection clockwise by degrees about its centre.
commands.title: Rotate

commands.summary: Scales the selection about an anchor, the centre by default.
commands.title: Scale

commands.summary: Sets any of the selection's x, y, width, height and turn.
commands.title: Transform
